title: Cambodia Briefs 18-Country Military Attaché Corps on Border Situation
detail: Cambodia's Ministry of National Defence, led by Secretary of State Lt. Gen. Rath Dararoth, briefed the Phnom Penh Military Attaché Corps -- 22 representatives from 18 countries -- on developments leading to the 2025 armed clashes, the December 27, 2025 ceasefire, and the current security situation in border areas. The briefing noted temporary border markers placed between specific pillar pairs in November-December 2025 and described ongoing obstacles to normalization, including troop movements, barbed-wire barriers, container placements and construction of permanent structures that continue to disrupt civilian returns. Officials reaffirmed Cambodia's commitment to resolving the dispute through the Joint Boundary Commission and Joint Survey Teams.

title: Cambodia Protests Thai Military Helicopter Incursion Near Doung Border Gate
detail: A Thai military helicopter flew approximately 400 metres into Cambodian airspace near the Doung International Border Gate in Kamrieng district, Battambang province. Cambodia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs lodged a formal protest, calling the entry a breach of national sovereignty and citing Article 3(c) of the 1944 Chicago Convention on International Civil Aviation, which bars state aircraft from overflying another state without permission, as well as Point 6 of the de-escalation measures agreed at the December 27, 2025 GBC Special Meeting. The government called on Thailand 'to immediately cease such actions and honour its commitments to de-escalate the situation,' while reaffirming its own commitment to peaceful resolution.

media.caption: Cambodia protests a Thai military helicopter's incursion into its airspace near the Doung border gate
